turns.user: I want to build an app for my book club. We pick a book each month and everyone leaves a short review with a rating out of five.
turns.reply: What's your gut on that — accounts, or keep it name-and-go with no login?

turns.user: About twelve of us, all on our phones. We already have a WhatsApp group so I do not want chat in the app — just the books and the reviews.
turns.reply: *(waiting on your answer about accounts vs. name-and-go)*

turns.user: Yes, people need to sign in so we know whose review is whose. Nothing fancy, email and password is fine.
turns.reply:
Just to confirm — voting isn't something you asked for, so I'll leave it out for now: whoever organizes the club just adds the book manually each month. Let me know if that's wrong.

Next: pages. I'm thinking three: a **Library** (list of past/current books, and where you add a new one), a **Book detail** page (shows the book plus all its reviews, and where you leave your own review), and a simple **Sign in / Sign up** page. That covers it without extra pages to maintain — does that match what you pictured, or were you imagining a separate page just for "leave a review"?

turns.user: I thought about letting people propose books and vote, but honestly whoever hosts picks the book, so no voting. That is everything.
turns.reply:
Locked in. That's the scope: Library, Book detail, and Sign in/Sign up pages, with Member, Book, and Review as the core objects, email/password auth, no chat, no voting.

The one thing left open — whether members can edit/delete their own review later — is noted as a TODO for you to decide during build; it won't block getting started.

This is ready to hand off whenever you want to begin building in Noodl.

turns.user: Yes, those three pages are exactly right. Go with that.
turns.reply: Great — the scope is locked and recorded. You're all set to start building in Noodl whenever you're ready. Good luck with the book club app!

scope.summary: An app for a ~12-person book club: members sign in with email/password, see the monthly book pick, and leave a short review with a 1-5 rating. No chat (WhatsApp covers that) and no voting on picks.

scope.backend: Needed for auth (email/password) plus storing books, reviews, and members.
